entities.summary: Alexander Alexandrovich Shevchenko is a Kazakhstani professional tennis player. He has a career-high ATP singles ranking of world No. 45, achieved on 19 February 2024 and a doubles ranking of No. 406, achieved on 20 February 2023. He is currently the No. 2 Kazakhstani player.
